title: Project feature resources, grants, and condition effects where explicit
description:
Problem:
Class, subclass, ancestry, and feat features often contain deterministic grants or resource rules in prose. Some are already modeled through advancement, but feature-level effects are not consistently queryable by tools.

Implement:
- Add optional projection fields for clear feature mechanics:
  - resource use counts.
  - reset cadence such as short rest or long rest.
  - proficiency, language, tool, armor, weapon, and skill grants where explicit.
  - condition immunities/resistances/advantages where explicit.
  - spell grants where explicit.
- Do not attempt to model ambiguous narrative effects.
- Preserve source text.

Acceptance criteria:
- Character sheet/tooling can query common feature grants without parsing prose.
- Projection diagnostics identify records still prose-only.
- Tests cover representative class, subclass, ancestry, and feat features.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
close_reason: Implemented first-pass source-backed mechanics projections for spells, creature/action entries, features/ancestry/feats, and hazards; regenerated SRD pack; added schema validation, report, thaw note, and tests.
